passage.label: Ali 'Imran — Birth of Maryam; wife of Imran delivered female; Allah knows best what she delivered; male not like female; named her Maryam; sought refuge for her and offspring from Shaytan Rajim; Lord accepted her with good acceptance; caused her to grow well; put her in care of Zakariyya; whenever he entered mihrab found provision; said O Maryam where is this from; said it is from Allah; Allah provides whom He wills without account; thereupon Zakariyya called his Lord; grant me good offspring from Yourself; You are Hearer of supplication; angels called him while standing praying in mihrab; Allah gives glad tidings of Yahya confirming Word from Allah; sayyid, hasoor, prophet from righteous; said my Lord how can I have boy when old age reached me and wife barren; said thus Allah does what He wills; said my Lord make sign for me; said your sign you will not speak to people three days except by gesture; remember your Lord much; glorify evening and morning

arabicExcerpts.text: فَلَمَّا وَضَعَتۡهَا قَالَتۡ رَبِّ إِنِّي وَضَعۡتُهَآ أُنثَىٰ وَٱللَّهُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا وَضَعَتۡ وَلَيۡسَ ٱلذَّكَرُ كَٱلۡأُنثَىٰۖ وَإِنِّي سَمَّيۡتُهَا مَرۡيَمَ وَإِنِّيٓ أُعِيذُهَا بِكَ وَذُرِّيَّتَهَا مِنَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنِ ٱلرَّجِيمِ

فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٖ وَأَنۢبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنٗا وَكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّاۖ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيۡهَا زَكَرِيَّا ٱلۡمِحۡرَابَ وَجَدَ عِندَهَا رِزۡقٗاۖ قَالَ يَٰمَرۡيَمُ أَنَّىٰ لَكِ هَٰذَاۖ قَالَتۡ هُوَ مِنۡ عِندِ ٱللَّهِۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرۡزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابٍ
هُنَالِكَ دَعَا زَكَرِيَّا رَبَّهُۥۖ قَالَ رَبِّ هَبۡ لِي مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةٗ طَيِّبَةًۖ إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
فَنَادَتۡهُ ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَهُوَ قَآئِمٞ يُصَلِّي فِي ٱلۡمِحۡرَابِ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُبَشِّرُكَ بِيَحۡيَىٰ مُصَدِّقَۢا بِكَلِمَةٖ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَسَيِّدٗا وَحَصُورٗا وَنَبِيّٗا مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِي غُلَٰمٞ وَقَدۡ بَلَغَنِيَ ٱلۡكِبَرُ وَٱمۡرَأَتِي عَاقِرٞۖ قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱللَّهُ يَفۡعَلُ مَا يَشَآءُ
قَالَ رَبِّ ٱجۡعَل لِّيٓ ءَايَةٗۖ قَالَ ءَايَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ ٱلنَّاسَ ثَلَٰثَةَ أَيَّامٍ إِلَّا رَمۡزٗاۗ وَٱذۡكُر رَّبَّكَ كَثِيرٗا وَسَبِّحۡ بِٱلۡعَشِيِّ وَٱلۡإِبۡكَٰرِ

mainSubject.label: Birth and dedication of Maryam: mother's surprise at female child; divine knowledge surpassing human expectation; naming and seeking protection from Satan; Allah's gracious acceptance and nurturing of Maryam; Zakariyya's guardianship and discovery of miraculous provision; Maryam's attribution of provision to Allah; divine unlimited provision principle; Zakariyya's supplication for righteous offspring prompted by witnessing miracle; angelic announcement of Yahya as confirmer of divine Word, leader, abstainer, prophet; Zakariyya's astonishment at prospect of son in old age with barren wife; divine omnipotence declaration; sign of three-day speechlessness; command to abundant remembrance and glorification

notes: Pass A Imran passage 5/8. Continues from wife of Imran's vow (3:35). Establishes Maryam's unique status, Zakariyya-Yahya narrative parallel to Isa narrative. Miraculous provision prefigures Isa's miracles. Three-day silence sign parallels Isa's cradle speech.
